text.title: What do you really love?
paragraphs: Do you **collect** small things? Take our quiz and find out about you! Be honest — and count your a, b and c answers!
1. Your friend gives you a **key ring** from Paris. You say: a) “Thank you! I **collect** them!” b) “It is nice.” c) “I do not want it.”
2. You see new **stickers** in a shop. You: a) buy all of them b) buy one c) walk past them
3. Your old toys are in a box. You: a) love them and keep them b) give them to your cousin c) **hate** them
4. Your friend talks about football for an hour. You think: a) “Great! I love it!” b) “It is OK.” c) “This is **boring**!” d) “Football is my **favourite** sport too!”
Mostly a? You are a collector! Mostly b? You are relaxed. Mostly c? You like new things, not old things! Show this quiz to your family. Is your mother a collector too?
